baseline.description: Without the skill, browser QA requires the user to manually chain Playwright commands, handle daemon lifecycle, debug cookie import, and remember platform-specific flags.

without_skill.notes: User must know Playwright API, daemon start/stop, cookie format, and OS-specific headed mode flags

with_skill.notes: Skill provides command patterns, cookie workflow, challenge protocol, and handoff — single-pass execution

evals.name: trigger-open-url
evals.prompt: Open https://staging.myapp.io and take a screenshot to verify the deploy looks right
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, runs goto + screenshot sequence
assertions: Skill is loaded and referenced in response

evals.name: trigger-test-user-flow
evals.prompt: Test the signup flow on our app — fill in the email field, click submit, and check what happens
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, uses fill + click + snapshot
assertions: Uses fill command for email input
Uses snapshot or text to verify result

evals.name: trigger-verify-ui
evals.prompt: Can you verify that the login page renders correctly and there are no console errors?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, uses goto + snapshot + console
assertions: Uses console command to check for errors

evals.name: trigger-debug-network
evals.prompt: I'm seeing slow load times on the dashboard — can you check the network requests and see what's taking so long?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, uses goto + network
assertions: Uses network command to inspect requests

evals.name: trigger-screenshot-proof
evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of https://example.com/pricing as proof for the client
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, runs goto + screenshot
assertions: Screenshot is saved to a file path

evals.name: trigger-cookie-auth-test
evals.prompt: I need to test an authenticated page — import my cookies and browse to the admin panel
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, uses cookie-import + goto
assertions: Security warnings about cookie handling are mentioned

evals.name: trigger-indirect-qa
evals.prompt: I just deployed to staging, can you do a quick sanity check on the homepage?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers for QA verification

evals.name: trigger-cloudflare-challenge
evals.prompt: This site has Cloudflare protection, can you try to get past the challenge page and grab the content?
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers, references challenge protocol
assertions: Challenge protocol is referenced or followed

evals.name: no-trigger-write-playwright-test
evals.prompt: Write a Playwright end-to-end test file for the checkout flow with assertions
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — user wants to write Playwright test code, not use the browse daemon
assertions: Response helps write Playwright test code directly

evals.name: no-trigger-install-playwright
evals.prompt: How do I install Playwright in my project and configure it for CI?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — general Playwright setup question, not a browse/QA task

evals.name: no-trigger-web-scraping-code
evals.prompt: Write me a Python web scraper using BeautifulSoup to extract product prices from this site
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — web scraping code request, not browser QA

evals.name: no-trigger-css-debug
evals.prompt: The button CSS is wrong, the padding is off — can you fix the stylesheet?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — CSS code fix, not browser verification

evals.name: no-trigger-api-testing
evals.prompt: Test the /api/users endpoint with curl and check the JSON response
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — API testing via curl, not browser-based
assertions: Response uses curl or similar HTTP tool

evals.name: no-trigger-browser-extension
evals.prompt: Help me build a Chrome extension that modifies the DOM on page load
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — building a browser extension, not QA browsing

evals.name: no-trigger-fetch-url-content
evals.prompt: Fetch the content of this documentation page and summarize it for me
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — content fetching/summarization, not interactive browser QA
assertions: Uses WebFetch or similar read-only tool

evals.name: no-trigger-puppeteer-migration
evals.prompt: I need to migrate my Puppeteer tests to Playwright — what are the API differences?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger — migration guidance, not a browse/QA task

evals.name: functional-full-qa-flow
evals.prompt: Navigate to https://example.com, take a snapshot of the page content, check for console errors, and screenshot the result
evals.expected_output: Complete QA flow executed in sequence

evals.name: functional-form-interaction
evals.prompt: Go to https://example.com/contact, fill in the name field with 'Test User', fill email with 'test@example.com', and click the submit button
evals.expected_output: Form interaction completed with fill + click
assertions: goto navigates to the form page
fill is used for name and email fields with correct selectors
snapshot or text verifies the result after submission

evals.name: functional-cookie-import-auth
evals.prompt: Import cookies from /tmp/cookies.json and then browse to the authenticated dashboard at https://app.example.com/dashboard
evals.expected_output: Cookie import followed by authenticated navigation
assertions: cookie-import command is used with correct file path
Security note about cookie handling is mentioned
goto navigates to dashboard after import
snapshot or screenshot verifies authenticated state

evals.name: functional-headed-handoff
evals.prompt: I need to test a page behind MFA — start headed mode so I can complete the login manually, then continue with automation
evals.expected_output: Handoff protocol is followed
assertions: User is asked to complete manual step
Automation resumes after manual step with snapshot/assertions

evals.name: functional-network-debug
evals.prompt: Go to https://app.example.com/dashboard and check if there are any failed network requests or slow API calls
evals.expected_output: Network inspection with analysis
assertions: Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are identified if present
Slow requests are flagged if present

evals.name: edge-case-empty-page
evals.prompt: Navigate to https://example.com/404 and tell me what the page shows
evals.expected_output: Handles non-existent page gracefully
assertions: snapshot or text returns whatever content exists
Error page content is reported to user

evals.name: edge-case-challenge-page
evals.prompt: Try to access https://protected-site.example.com which has Cloudflare protection
evals.expected_output: Challenge protocol is activated
assertions: Headed mode switch is attempted if in headless
Screenshot of challenge state is captured
Status of challenge resolution is reported
